title: An Observation's own malformed meta or effectivePeriod (top-level or contained in a report) is dropped by .catch(undefined), so the result loses its draw and lands on its issued date (or its report's). Predates PR 1253; the report-level copies are strict since PR 1269
evidence: Done 2026-11-27 (PR 2181, US-72 AC18): a Health Records lab result is judged on one date (effectiveDateTime, then effectivePeriod.start, then issued); a present but malformed date is unusable, and a new result with an unusable date is skipped and counted (undated), never re-dated; meta stays lenient. Pinned by packages/health-core/src/health-records-undated.test.ts.
